Customer Support Guide
Support Channels
●
In-app live chat, available 24/7 for order-related issues.
●
Phone support, available during business hours for urgent issues (payment disputes, undelivered
high-value items).
●
Email support for non-urgent inquiries, with a response target of 24-48 hours.
Complaint Handling Process
●
Step 1: Customer raises an issue with the order ID and description.
●
Step 2: Support agent reviews order history, delivery status, and any prior communication.
●
Step 3: Agent proposes a resolution — replacement, return, refund, or voucher compensation.
●
Step 4: If unresolved, the case is escalated to a senior support specialist within 24 hours.
Escalation Guidelines
●

●

Escalation Guidelines
●
Cases involving safety issues, fraud, or repeated failed resolutions are escalated immediately to the
Trust & Safety team.
●
Customers are kept informed of case status at every stage via app notification and email.
Service Standards
●
First response time target: under 5 minutes for live chat, under 2 hours for phone queue.
●
Customer satisfaction is measured after each resolved case via a short feedback survey.

Delivery Guidelines
Delivery Process
●
Once an order is confirmed, it is packed by the seller or Daraz warehouse and handed to a courier
partner.
●
Customers receive tracking updates at each stage: Order Confirmed, Packed, Shipped, Out for
Delivery, Delivered.
●
A delivery attempt includes a call or SMS to the customer; if unreachable, up to 2 more attempts are
made before the order is returned to the seller.
Delivery Locations
●
Standard delivery covers all major cities and most rural areas via courier partners.
●
Remote areas may have limited courier coverage, in which case delivery may take longer or require
pickup from a designated point.
Cash on Delivery (COD)
●
COD is available for most products, with a maximum order value limit that may vary by region.
●

Cash on Delivery (COD)
●
COD is available for most products, with a maximum order value limit that may vary by region.
●
Customers must have the exact or close amount ready, as couriers may not always carry large
amounts of change.
Failed Deliveries
●
If a package cannot be delivered after 3 attempts, it is returned to the seller and the customer is
notified.
●
Repeated failed deliveries on a customer's account may result in COD being disabled for future
orders.

Delivery Timelines
Standard Timelines
●
Major cities: 2-4 business days from order confirmation.
●
Other urban areas: 4-6 business days.
●
Remote or rural areas: 6-10 business days, depending on courier network coverage.
Express Delivery
●
Available for select products and locations, with delivery in 24-48 hours for an additional fee shown at
checkout.
Factors That May Delay Delivery
●
Public holidays, severe weather, high-demand sale events (e.g. 11.11, 12.12), and incomplete or
incorrect addresses.
●
Customs clearance delays for items shipped from international sellers.
Tracking a Delivery
●
Customers can track real-time status from 'My Orders' > 'Track Order', which shows the current courier
checkpoint.
●

Tracking a Delivery
●
Customers can track real-time status from 'My Orders' > 'Track Order', which shows the current courier
checkpoint.
●
If a delivery is delayed beyond the estimated window, customers can contact Customer Support for an
update or compensation voucher where applicable.

Payment FAQs
Common Questions
●
Q: My payment was deducted but the order shows as failed. A: This is usually a temporary hold; it is
auto-reversed within 5-7 business days if the order did not confirm.
●
Q: Can I change my payment method after placing an order? A: No, the payment method cannot be
changed once an order is placed; the order must be cancelled and re-placed.
●
Q: Is it safe to save my card details? A: Saved cards are stored securely by the payment processor
using encryption; Daraz does not store full card numbers.
Failed Payment Troubleshooting
●
Check that the card has sufficient balance and online transactions are enabled.
●
Try an alternate payment method (wallet, COD if available) if the card payment repeatedly fails.
●

●
Try an alternate payment method (wallet, COD if available) if the card payment repeatedly fails.
●
Contact your bank if the amount was deducted but the order was not confirmed after 7 business days.
Promo Codes & Vouchers
●
Vouchers are applied at checkout and only valid for the stated date range, category, and minimum
order value.
●
Only one voucher can typically be applied per order, unless explicitly stated as 'stackable'.

Accepted Payment Methods
Available Payment Options
●
Cash on Delivery (COD) — pay in cash when the order arrives, subject to an order value limit.
●
Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard) via secure checkout.
●
Mobile wallets and bank transfer options, where available in the customer's region.
●
Daraz Wallet balance, which can be topped up or accumulated through refunds and cashback.
Installment Plans
●
Select banks offer 0% installment plans on purchases above a minimum amount; eligibility is shown at
checkout if the customer's card qualifies.
Payment Security
●
All online payments are processed through PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways.
●
Customers are advised never to share OTPs (one-time passwords) with anyone, including people
claiming to be Daraz support.

Refund Procedures
When a Refund Is Issued
●
After a returned item is received and inspected by the seller or warehouse and confirmed to meet
return eligibility.
●
Immediately for orders that were never dispatched or were cancelled before shipping.
●
For failed deliveries where the customer already made an online payment.
Refund Methods
●
Online payments (card, wallet) are refunded to the original payment method.
●
Cash on Delivery (COD) orders are refunded to the customer's Daraz Wallet or via bank transfer, since
there is no original payment method to reverse.
●
Customers may sometimes be offered a choice between a wallet credit (faster) or original payment
method refund (slower).
Refund Process Steps
●
Step 1: Returned item arrives at the seller/warehouse and is logged.
●

Refund Process Steps
●
Step 1: Returned item arrives at the seller/warehouse and is logged.
●
Step 2: Quality check confirms the item matches the return reason.
●
Step 3: Refund is approved and initiated to the chosen refund method.
●
Step 4: Customer receives a confirmation notification with the refund reference number.

Refund Timelines
Processing Time by Method
●
Daraz Wallet credit: usually within 24-48 hours after refund approval.
●
Credit/debit card refunds: 5-10 business days, depending on the issuing bank.
●
Bank transfer refunds: 3-7 business days after approval.
What Affects Refund Speed
●
How quickly the returned item is received and inspected.
●
Bank processing times, which Daraz does not control once the refund is initiated on their end.
●
Incomplete customer bank details, which can delay bank transfer refunds until corrected.
Checking Refund Status
●
Customers can check refund status under 'My Orders' > 'Returns & Refunds', which shows each stage
with a timestamp.
●
If a refund is not received within the stated window, customers should contact Customer Support with

with a timestamp.
●
If a refund is not received within the stated window, customers should contact Customer Support with
the order ID and refund reference number.

Return Eligibility Guidelines
Eligibility Checklist
●
The return request must be raised within the applicable return window for that product category.
●
The item must be in its original condition, with tags, labels, and packaging intact, unless the return
reason is 'damaged' or 'wrong item'.
●
Proof of purchase (order ID) is required for every return; returns cannot be processed without it.
Category-Specific Rules
●
Mobile phones and laptops: eligible for return only if the defect is confirmed by a technical inspection
within the return window.
●
Beauty and personal care: only eligible if the seal is unbroken and the product is unused.
●
Furniture and large appliances: return requires the item to be repackaged in original packaging; pickup
may take 3-5 extra days due to size.

●

may take 3-5 extra days due to size.
When a Return Is Rejected
●
If the item shows signs of use beyond inspection, missing parts, or does not match the reported issue,
the return may be rejected and the item shipped back to the customer.
●
Customers are notified with a reason whenever a return is rejected, and may appeal through Customer
Support.

Return Policy
General Return Window
●
Most items purchased on Daraz can be returned within 7 days of delivery, unless a different window is
stated on the product page.
●
Electronics and appliances have a 7-day return window for manufacturing defects only, not
change-of-mind returns.
●
Fashion and apparel items have a 14-day return window, provided tags are still attached and the item
is unworn.
What Can Be Returned
●
Wrong item delivered (different from what was ordered).
●
Damaged or defective item on arrival.
●
Item significantly not as described on the product listing.
●
Change of mind, only for categories explicitly marked 'Free Returns' on the product page.
What Cannot Be Returned
●
Perishable goods, personal care items that have been opened or used, and items marked

What Cannot Be Returned
●
Perishable goods, personal care items that have been opened or used, and items marked
'Non-Returnable' on the listing.
●
Items returned without original packaging, accessories, or free gifts that came with the order.
How to Start a Return
●
Go to 'My Orders', select the item, and click 'Return / Refund'.
●
Choose a reason for the return and upload a photo if the item is damaged or wrong.
●
A courier will be scheduled to pick up the item, or you may be asked to drop it at a nearby collection
point.

Seller Onboarding Guide
Registration Requirements
●
A valid national ID or business registration document.
●
A bank account for receiving payments, registered under the seller's name or business name.
●
Basic business information: store name, contact details, and product categories to be sold.
Onboarding Steps
●
Step 1: Create a Seller Center account and submit required documents.
●
Step 2: Documents are verified by the Daraz seller support team, typically within 2-3 business days.
●
Step 3: Once approved, the seller completes store setup: store name, logo, and shipping settings.
●
Step 4: Seller lists their first products, which go through a basic quality review before going live.
Training & Support
●

●

Training & Support
●
New sellers get access to a Seller University with guides on listing optimization, pricing, and order
management.
●
A dedicated seller support channel is available for onboarding questions during the first 30 days.

Seller Policies
Listing Requirements
●
Sellers must provide accurate product titles, descriptions, images, and pricing that match the actual
item shipped.
●
Counterfeit, prohibited, or restricted items (e.g. weapons, certain medications) may not be listed.
Order Fulfillment Obligations
●
Sellers must confirm and pack orders within 24 hours of receiving them, and hand over to the courier
within the agreed pickup window.
●
Repeated late fulfillment or cancellations may result in lower seller ratings or listing visibility.
Returns & Refund Obligations for Sellers
●
Sellers must accept eligible returns per the platform's return policy and cannot impose stricter rules
than Daraz's stated policy.
●
Sellers are responsible for return shipping costs when the return reason is their fault (wrong or

than Daraz's stated policy.
●
Sellers are responsible for return shipping costs when the return reason is their fault (wrong or
damaged item).
Performance Standards
●
Sellers are evaluated on order defect rate, late shipment rate, and cancellation rate; consistently poor
performance can lead to account suspension.
